questions.prompt: What change does the announcement describe?
options: Giving developers responsibility for writing nature guidance.
Replacing local planning decisions with national inspections.
Concentrating expert advice on more complex planning work.
Moving nature protection work from specialists to volunteers.
questions.explanationZh: 核心是把专家建议集中用于复杂项目，常规事项更多使用现有指导；没有转交志愿者等安排。

questions.prompt: Why is Natural England changing its approach?
options: Specialists have been handling many requests, even where guidance exists.
Local authorities have stopped considering environmental effects.
Developers have asked for every project to receive identical advice.
Existing protection rules have been removed from planning law.
questions.explanationZh: 需求增加，许多请求属于已有指导覆盖的情形，因此希望更有效使用专家力量。

questions.prompt: What remains unchanged in the announcement?
options: The procedure for every individual request.
The time at which every project receives advice.
The number of partners involved in planning.
The organisation’s legal duties to protect nature.
questions.explanationZh: 建议提供方式改变，但法定自然保护责任与相关保护依旧存在。

questions.prompt: What should a local authority expect during the transition?
options: All current guidance will be withdrawn immediately.
New arrangements will develop with guidance and cooperation.
Each routine case will receive a new specialist report.
Environmental problems will be solved before planning begins.
questions.explanationZh: 逐步推行、持续合作与更新指导共同支持这个判断；并非立即撤销指导或保证问题已解决。
